title: Each new notes or debt line names its fix, and the report guard refuses a RECORDED gap with no started fix
why: Owner, 13:25 CST Nov 7: "I want the guard itself".
note: Each new notes.md or debt line names its fix: a step, a lane, or a listed reason for none. The report guard refuses a RECORDED gap with no started fix. Done: red tests for a notes line with no fix and a RECORDED gap with no started fix, then green.
